scope: Independent Python reads of six complete run receipts, actual rows, TSV/query hashes, catalog and small input hashes; no Java/new measurement/retry. Three fixed-order paired observations per query are descriptive diagnostics, not percentile/stability estimates or replacements for CI.
resetMode: per-query-cold; indexes reset each query, JIT/OS page cache not reset
scale: Reference lens >15% AND >1ms, repeated in >=2 pairs; descriptive use of existing old34 scale only, not a new v3 acceptance gate. Raw slower observations retained independently of this scale.
limitations: Six graph-content before/after inventories are byte-identical and match run hashes, relying on runner recorded underlying file hashes; no rehash of persisted graph/JAR contents by auditor.
Full actual values/order/provenance equal independent catalog expectations; complete hit census is catalog evidence, returned LIMIT200 graph IDs are not the full hit set.

SAM bytecode/source mechanism is independently reviewed elsewhere; work differences can include scheduling-dependent speculative work and do not identify a new optimization or explain all latency deltas.
and-broad-all-distinct is slower in all three observations but by less than 2%; mixed-four-few-distinct is slower in two, with >1s absolute pair3 change but <15% relative. Retained, not dismissed.
Final10x and CI gates remain separate; no three-observation P95 or stable gain claimed.
